# gws persona: Project Manager

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — the Project Manager persona: a role playbook that tells an agent how to operate as a PM on Google Workspace — relevant workflows (`+standup-report`, `+weekly-digest`, `+file-announce`), concrete instructions (track status in Sheets with `gws sheets +append`, share artifacts via Drive then `+file-announce`, schedule standups with `gws calendar +insert`, send status emails with `gws gmail +send`) and practical tips (jq piping, `--dry-run` before writes). Distinct from the lot 31 personas (`persona-researcher`, `persona-exec-assistant` — different roles, different instructions). By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: requires the `gws` binary and a Google account (browser OAuth is free); the cited `gws-drive`, `gws-sheets`, `gws-gmail`, `gws-calendar`, `gws-chat` prerequisite skills come from the same repo but are not listed in this catalog; install the prerequisite `googleworkspace-cli-gws-shared` first. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
